summary: @ornikar/prismic-components ships a preinstall dropper that downloads Bun to execute a 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script that runs `setup.mjs` (obfuscated with `_0xNNNN` identifiers). setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/`, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses `execFileSync` to invoke it against the shipped `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB bundle carrying a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header and heavy string-array-rotation obfuscation (a large mixed literal array and a shuffle helper `function WV8StW(...){...MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())...}`), unreviewable by Node-based tooling and unrelated to the package's advertised purpose of Prismic CMS components. package.json declares `main: index.js` but no such file exists in the tarball; the only shipped files are `package.json`, `setup.mjs`, and `math_init.js`, so the package has no library surface — its sole effect on `npm install` is to bootstrap an alien runtime to execute the obfuscated blob. The alternate-runtime + obfuscated payload + missing declared main + advertised-purpose mismatch match the alternate-runtime-dropper fingerprint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
